issue.title: Second mind flags claims the reply never made ('what I just said about 128')
issue.symptom: Discord DM 2026-11-12: after 'It's in the Grotto now (palace_id: 2026-11-12_8fddd0dba2)' the second mind posted '*[Second mind]* I can't back up what I just said about 128, so please check that' (no 128 in the reply; likely from the palace id or a token count); after 'The Discord API rejected that channel name — the-grotto...' it posted 'I can't back up what I just said about Discord'. Its notices should name only claims present in the reply, and ids/numbers from tool results aren't claims.

regression_test.format: pytest functions added by the fix
regression_test.gold:
# candidates/gaia-core/tests/test_second_mind_b9ts.py
"""The other mind answers blind; the code looks for what nothing backs (b9ts)."""
import json

import pytest

from gaia_core.cognition import second_mind as sm


def test_ids_and_named_tools_are_not_claims_0kv2():
    """Discord DM 2026-11-12: 'I can't back up what I just said about 128' (no 128
    in the reply) and '... about Discord' (it described the discord call's error)."""
    from gaia_core.cognition.second_mind import unbacked
    assert unbacked("It's in the Grotto now (palace_id: 2026-11-12_8fddd0dba2).",
                    "Post in the Grotto\npalace(store) (palace): stored") == []
    assert unbacked("The Discord API rejected that channel name.",
                    "Post in the Grotto\ndiscord(post) (discord): not a channel she can post to: 'the-grotto'") == []
    assert unbacked("The capital is Paris, with 2148271 people.", "What is the capital of France?") == ["Paris", "2148271"]
